title: Treaty of Huế (1863)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Huế (1863)", at revision 1378711157, opens: "The Treaty of Huế is a treaty signed on April 14, 1863, between representatives of Đại Nam and the French Empire." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3434536, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1863 treaty between Vietnam and France". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
